question: Can creator focus/selection and contextual inspection coexist with speaking/listening/current-opportunity Stage meanings without any one state visually or semantically impersonating another?
accepted_grammar: Keyboard focus is a navigation witness and may move without selection or fictional change.
Creator selection establishes an inspection target and does not imply fictional salience, current opportunity or Character agency.
Speaking/listening remain current Stage state; listening Characters remain visibly present.
Current opportunity remains a separate Stage/Director-facing meaning and is not inferred from focus, selection or inspector presence.
Selected Character inspection follows Stage -> focus -> selection -> contextual inspection -> deeper inspection -> exact return without changing Character identity or Production truth.
Human-readable Character names remain the explicit identity anchor; color/portrait/glow are insufficient identity or state carriers.
fixture_basis: Gilligan’s Isle / The Missing Raft with Marlowe, Dr. Voss, Wren, Iona and Keir is used only as the frozen Stage-anchor illustrative witness. Five Characters are not promoted to a cardinality law.

defects_repaired: Initial Character name/state children expanded cone scroll width at every required viewport; labels were constrained to the carrier width with wrapping while preserving visible identity/state text.
The geometry-repair write path double-encoded UTF-8 punctuation/identity text; exact UTF-8 was restored and the complete matrix rerun.
The first shell mixed The White Current/The Tides Remember with the Missing Raft Character set; it was corrected to the frozen Stage anchor’s Gilligan’s Isle/The Missing Raft fixture.

explicit_non_authority: No new cone geometry, floor/name hinge, pips, redundant identity symbol or portrait dependency.
No Director opportunity algorithm or scheduling semantics.
No transcript-dependent motion, cadence, timing or turn-taking authority; Q-DESIGN-02 remains blocked.
No intervention/Take/consequence/provider/Performer semantics and no Phase-D/runtime/shipping authority.
next_boundary: Run a static 2–5 present-Character composition/density stress study using the frozen cone/name/floor carrier as a design witness only. Do not infer a minimum/maximum active-Scene cardinality, reopen ODR-30, or replace PKT-STAGE-CORE-02.
approval: APPROVED BY STANDING DIRECTOR DELEGATION — CLEAN RECURSIVE AUDIT.
